snippet.title: EXTENDED Trailer & Game Intro Cinematic - Nicktoons & The Dice of Destiny
snippet.description:
The Extended Trailer is here!
Watch the Extended Trailer & Game Intro Cinematic for Nicktoons & The Dice of Destiny and witness the game intro scene and gameplay from an epic crossover quest. 

Nicktoons & The Dice of Destiny is a vibrant, universe-spanning mashup that brings iconic Nickelodeon heroes into a world of fantasy-style tropes and real-time RPG action. 

#NicktoonsRPG #DiceOfDestiny #Nickelodeon #NickelodeonGame
